items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of the interviewee (George Hudson) in relation to Sam Kenton. Sam Kenton is mentioned by the interviewer in a separate context regarding Clark Terry and Big Chief Moore.
